CREATE TABLE `course_assignments` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`courseId` int NOT NULL,
	`lecturerId` int NOT NULL,
	`assignedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `course_assignments_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `courses` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`code` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
	`name` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
	`description` text,
	`credits` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
	`capacity` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
	`department` varchar(128),
	`level` enum('100','200','300','400','500','600') DEFAULT '100',
	`semesterId` int NOT NULL,
	`scheduleDay` varchar(64),
	`scheduleTime` varchar(64),
	`room` varchar(64),
	`prerequisites` text,
	`isActive` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `courses_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `enrollments` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`studentId` int NOT NULL,
	`courseId` int NOT NULL,
	`semesterId` int NOT NULL,
	`status` enum('enrolled','dropped','completed','waitlisted') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'enrolled',
	`enrolledAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`droppedAt` timestamp,
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `enrollments_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `grades` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`enrollmentId` int NOT NULL,
	`assignmentScore` decimal(5,2),
	`midtermScore` decimal(5,2),
	`finalScore` decimal(5,2),
	`totalScore` decimal(5,2),
	`letterGrade` varchar(4),
	`gradePoints` decimal(3,2),
	`remarks` text,
	`gradedBy` int,
	`gradedAt` timestamp,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `grades_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT `grades_enrollmentId_unique` UNIQUE(`enrollmentId`)
);

CREATE TABLE `notifications` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`title` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
	`message` text NOT NULL,
	`type` enum('info','success','warning','error') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info',
	`isRead` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
	`link` varchar(512),
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `notifications_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `semesters` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
	`academicYear` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
	`term` enum('Fall','Spring','Summer') NOT NULL,
	`startDate` date NOT NULL,
	`endDate` date NOT NULL,
	`enrollmentDeadline` date,
	`dropDeadline` date,
	`isActive` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `semesters_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

ALTER TABLE `users` MODIFY COLUMN `role` enum('student','lecturer','admin') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'student';
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `studentId` varchar(32);
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `employeeId` varchar(32);
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `department` varchar(128);
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `phone` varchar(32);
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `address` text;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `dateOfBirth` date;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `profilePicture` text;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `bio` text;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `isActive` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL;
